# Generated by tools/gecko_special_troops.cjs. Country scope.

gecko_special_floor = {
	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_remainder which = $variable$ }
	while = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = gecko_special_remainder value = 1 } }
		subtract_variable = { which = gecko_special_remainder value = 1 }
	}
	subtract_variable = { which = $variable$ which = gecko_special_remainder }
}

gecko_special_pay = {
	while = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = gecko_special_payment value = 1000 } }
		add_treasury = -1000
		subtract_variable = { which = gecko_special_payment value = 1000 }
	}
	while = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = gecko_special_payment value = 100 } }
		add_treasury = -100
		subtract_variable = { which = gecko_special_payment value = 100 }

	while = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = gecko_special_payment value = 10 } }
		add_treasury = -10
		subtract_variable = { which = gecko_special_payment value = 10 }
	}
	while = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = gecko_special_payment value = 1 } }
		add_treasury = -1
		subtract_variable = { which = gecko_special_payment value = 1 }

		limit = { check_variable = { which = gecko_special_payment value = 0.1 } }
		add_treasury = -0.1
		subtract_variable = { which = gecko_special_payment value = 0.1 }

	while = {

		add_treasury = -0.01
		subtract_variable = { which = gecko_special_payment value = 0.01 }

}

gecko_special_marines_calculate = {
	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_strength value = 1 }
	export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_reserve value = trigger_value:sailors }
	export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_cap value = land_forcelimit }
	export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_fraction value = modifier:allowed_marine_fraction }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_cap which = gecko_special_fraction }
	export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_extra value = modifier:special_unit_forcelimit }
	change_variable = { which = gecko_special_extra value = 1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_cap which = gecko_special_extra }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = gecko_special_cap value = 0 } } } set_variable = { which = gecko_special_cap value = 0 } }
	gecko_special_floor = { variable = gecko_special_cap }
	export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_fielded value = trigger_value:num_of_marines }
	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_remaining which = gecko_special_cap }
	subtract_variable = { which = gecko_special_remaining which = gecko_special_fielded }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = gecko_special_remaining value = 0 } } } set_variable = { which = gecko_special_remaining value = 0 } }
	export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = modifier:infantry_cost }
	export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_extra value = modifier:global_regiment_cost }
	change_variable = { which = gecko_special_price which = gecko_special_extra }
	change_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = 0.1 } } } set_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = 0.1 } }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = 10 }
	export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_extra value = modifier:special_unit_cost_modifier }
	change_variable = { which = gecko_special_extra value = 1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_price which = gecko_special_extra }
	capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = gecko_special_capital export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_local_price value = modifier:local_regiment_cost } }
	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_local_price which = event_target:gecko_special_capital }
	change_variable = { which = gecko_special_local_price value = 1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_price which = gecko_special_local_price }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = 0 } } } set_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = 0 } }
	gecko_special_tiers = yes
}

gecko_special_marines_recruit = {
	gecko_special_marines_calculate = yes
	if = {
		limit = { gecko_special_marines_unlocked = yes gecko_special_can_recruit = { tier = $tier$ resource = sailors } }
		set_variable = { which = gecko_special_payment which = gecko_special_cost_$tier$ }
		gecko_special_pay = yes
		for_variable_amount = {
			variable = gecko_special_amount_$tier$
			effect = "capital_scope = { marine_infantry = PREV } add_sailors = -1000"
		}
	}
	gecko_special_marines_calculate = yes
}

	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = 0 } } } set_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = 0 } }
	gecko_special_tiers = yes
}

gecko_special_qizilbash_cavalry_recruit = {
	gecko_special_qizilbash_cavalry_calculate = yes
	if = {
		limit = { gecko_special_qizilbash_cavalry_unlocked = yes gecko_special_can_recruit = { tier = $tier$ resource = manpower } }
		set_variable = { which = gecko_special_payment which = gecko_special_cost_$tier$ }
		gecko_special_pay = yes
		for_variable_amount = {
			variable = gecko_special_amount_$tier$
			effect = "capital_scope = { qizilbash_cavalry = PREV } add_manpower = -1"
		}
	}
	gecko_special_qizilbash_cavalry_calculate = yes
}

gecko_special_caroleans_calculate = {
	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_strength value = 1 }
	export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_reserve value = manpower }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_reserve value = 1000 }
	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_cap value = 0 }
	every_owned_province = {
		limit = { has_local_modifier_value = { which = local_has_carolean value = 1 } }
		export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_cap value = modifier:local_amount_of_carolean }
		export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_development value = development }
		export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_extra value = modifier:amount_of_carolean who = ROOT }
		multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_development which = gecko_special_extra }
		change_variable = { which = gecko_special_cap which = gecko_special_development }
		owner = { change_variable = { which = gecko_special_cap which = PREV } }
	}
	export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_extra value = modifier:special_unit_forcelimit }
	change_variable = { which = gecko_special_extra value = 1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_cap which = gecko_special_extra }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = gecko_special_cap value = 0 } } } set_variable = { which = gecko_special_cap value = 0 } }
	gecko_special_floor = { variable = gecko_special_cap }
	export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_fielded value = trigger_value:num_of_carolean }
	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_remaining which = gecko_special_cap }
	subtract_variable = { which = gecko_special_remaining which = gecko_special_fielded }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = gecko_special_remaining value = 0 } } } set_variable = { which = gecko_special_remaining value = 0 } }
	export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = modifier:infantry_cost }
	export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_extra value = modifier:global_regiment_cost }
	change_variable = { which = gecko_special_price which = gecko_special_extra }
	change_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = 0.1 } } } set_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = 0.1 } }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = 10 }
	export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_extra value = modifier:special_unit_cost_modifier }
	change_variable = { which = gecko_special_extra value = 1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_price which = gecko_special_extra }
	capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = gecko_special_capital export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_local_price value = modifier:local_regiment_cost } }
	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_local_price which = event_target:gecko_special_capital }
	change_variable = { which = gecko_special_local_price value = 1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_price which = gecko_special_local_price }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = 0 } } } set_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = 0 } }
	gecko_special_tiers = yes
}

gecko_special_caroleans_recruit = {
	gecko_special_caroleans_calculate = yes
	if = {
		limit = { gecko_special_caroleans_unlocked = yes gecko_special_can_recruit = { tier = $tier$ resource = manpower } }
		set_variable = { which = gecko_special_payment which = gecko_special_cost_$tier$ }
		gecko_special_pay = yes
		for_variable_amount = {
			variable = gecko_special_amount_$tier$
			effect = "capital_scope = { carolean_infantry = PREV } add_manpower = -1"
		}

gecko_special_hussars_calculate = {
	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_strength value = 1 }
	export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_reserve value = manpower }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_reserve value = 1000 }
	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_cap value = 0 }
	every_owned_province = {
		limit = { OR = { culture = ROOT owner = { accepted_culture = PREV } } }
		export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_cap value = modifier:local_amount_of_hussars }
		owner = { change_variable = { which = gecko_special_cap which = PREV } }
	}
	export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_extra value = modifier:amount_of_hussars }
	change_variable = { which = gecko_special_cap which = gecko_special_extra }
	export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_extra value = modifier:special_unit_forcelimit }
	change_variable = { which = gecko_special_extra value = 1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_cap which = gecko_special_extra }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = gecko_special_cap value = 0 } } } set_variable = { which = gecko_special_cap value = 0 } }
	gecko_special_floor = { variable = gecko_special_cap }
	export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_fielded value = trigger_value:num_of_hussars }
	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_remaining which = gecko_special_cap }
	subtract_variable = { which = gecko_special_remaining which = gecko_special_fielded }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = gecko_special_remaining value = 0 } } } set_variable = { which = gecko_special_remaining value = 0 } }
	export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = modifier:cavalry_cost }
	export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_extra value = modifier:global_regiment_cost }
	change_variable = { which = gecko_special_price which = gecko_special_extra }
	change_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = 0.1 } } } set_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = 0.1 } }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = 25 }
	export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_extra value = modifier:special_unit_cost_modifier }
	change_variable = { which = gecko_special_extra value = 1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_price which = gecko_special_extra }
	capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = gecko_special_capital export_to_variable = { which = gecko_special_local_price value = modifier:local_regiment_cost } }
	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_local_price which = event_target:gecko_special_capital }
	change_variable = { which = gecko_special_local_price value = 1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_price which = gecko_special_local_price }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = 0 } } } set_variable = { which = gecko_special_price value = 0 } }
	gecko_special_tiers = yes
}

gecko_special_tiers = {
	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_amount_25 which = gecko_special_remaining }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_amount_25 value = 0.25 }
	gecko_special_floor = { variable = gecko_special_amount_25 }
	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_mp_25 which = gecko_special_amount_25 }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_mp_25 which = gecko_special_strength }
	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_men_25 which = gecko_special_amount_25 }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_men_25 which = gecko_special_strength }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_men_25 value = 1000 }
	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_cost_25 which = gecko_special_amount_25 }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_cost_25 which = gecko_special_price }
	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_amount_50 which = gecko_special_remaining }

	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_men_50 which = gecko_special_amount_50 }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_men_50 which = gecko_special_strength }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_men_50 value = 1000 }
	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_cost_50 which = gecko_special_amount_50 }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_cost_50 which = gecko_special_price }
	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_amount_75 which = gecko_special_remaining }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_amount_75 value = 0.75 }
	gecko_special_floor = { variable = gecko_special_amount_75 }
	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_mp_75 which = gecko_special_amount_75 }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_mp_75 which = gecko_special_strength }
	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_men_75 which = gecko_special_amount_75 }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_men_75 which = gecko_special_strength }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_men_75 value = 1000 }
	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_cost_75 which = gecko_special_amount_75 }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_cost_75 which = gecko_special_price }

	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_men_100 which = gecko_special_amount_100 }

	set_variable = { which = gecko_special_cost_100 which = gecko_special_amount_100 }
	multiply_variable = { which = gecko_special_cost_100 which = gecko_special_price }
}

gecko_special_refresh = {
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = gecko_special_selection value = 1 } } gecko_special_marines_calculate = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = gecko_special_selection value = 2 } } gecko_special_heavy_infantry_calculate = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = gecko_special_selection value = 3 } } gecko_special_heavy_cavalry_calculate = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = gecko_special_selection value = 4 } } gecko_special_mamluk_infantry_calculate = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = gecko_special_selection value = 5 } } gecko_special_mamluk_cavalry_calculate = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = gecko_special_selection value = 6 } } gecko_special_streltsy_calculate = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = gecko_special_selection value = 7 } } gecko_special_rajputs_calculate = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = gecko_special_selection value = 8 } } gecko_special_guard_infantry_calculate = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = gecko_special_selection value = 9 } } gecko_special_guard_cavalry_calculate = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = gecko_special_selection value = 10 } } gecko_special_tercios_calculate = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = gecko_special_selection value = 11 } } gecko_special_musketeers_calculate = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = gecko_special_selection value = 12 } } gecko_special_samurai_calculate = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = gecko_special_selection value = 13 } } gecko_special_qizilbash_infantry_calculate = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = gecko_special_selection value = 14 } } gecko_special_qizilbash_cavalry_calculate = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = gecko_special_selection value = 15 } } gecko_special_caroleans_calculate = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = gecko_special_selection value = 16 } } gecko_special_hussars_calculate = yes }
}
